battle.name: 英國-索馬里戰爭
battle.brief: 一九〇〇年初，英屬索馬里蘭保護地與內陸的德里維什國開戰，德里維什先取杰吉加、再迫近哈爾蓋薩，英方以索馬里蘭駱駝兵團為主力出擊；卡面的加特林機槍是團級支援火器，留在澤拉與貝爾貝拉的守備單位及遠征隊預備隊，以持續橫向火力打散密集的頭巾隊，前線持續火力則由馬克沁與維克斯機槍承擔。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍在美國陸軍體系中屬團級支援火力，早期配屬步兵團的武器單位，用於對敵隊列施壓並提供持續射擊能力。

countries: 交戰一方是英屬索馬里蘭保護地：行政中樞在哈爾蓋薩，澤拉與貝爾貝拉是海岸線上的港口與補給點，地面守備由索馬里蘭保護地部隊與自印度調來的英印軍分遣隊擔任，一九〇〇年才成立的索馬里蘭駱駝兵團則成為唯一的本地野戰主力，全線由英國外交部派任的駐索馬里蘭總督統一指揮，遠征作戰命令自印度發出，海上封鎖與後勤輸送由皇家海軍東非分隊負責。另一方是索馬里亞內陸的德里維什國，都城在塔萊赫，由賽義德·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·哈桑自一八九九年起組建，其統治機器是由「迪萬」組成的行政機構、散落各處的堡寨，以及由部落青年組成、以「頭巾」為號的民兵隊伍，武器以進口步槍與長矛為主，一九〇四年起得到奧斯曼與德國的暗中支持。第三方是義大利殖民政府治下的本納迪爾與阿比西尼亞帝國：義軍在初期曾配合英方作戰，一九〇四年與英國訂立共同對付德里維什的協議；阿比西尼亞在杰吉加與奧加丹一線被擊敗後，轉為英方盟邦。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the British Somaliland Protectorate: its administrative centre was at Hargeisa, Zeila and Berbera were the port and supply points on the coast, ground defence was held by the Somaliland Protectorate Force together with detachments of British and Indian troops sent out from India, and the Somaliland Camel Corps, raised in 1900, became the one indigenous field force in the territory. Command ran through the Governor of British Somaliland appointed by the British Foreign Office; orders for the expeditions were issued from India, and the blockade of the coast and the carrying trade were in the hands of the Royal Navy's East Africa station. The other belligerent was the Dervish State in the interior of Somalia, its capital at Taleh, built up from 1899 by Sayyid Mohammed Abdullah Hassan. Its machinery of rule consisted of an administration organised as a diwan, a scatter of forts, and militia bands of tribal young men who took the turban as their badge, armed mainly with imported rifles and spears, and from 1904 it received covert support from the Ottoman Empire and Germany. Third parties were Italian colonial government in the Benadir and the Ethiopian Empire: Italian troops fought alongside the British in the early phase, and in 1904 Italy concluded an agreement with Britain to act jointly against the Dervishes; Ethiopia, after being defeated on the Jigjiga and Ogaden lines, turned into a British ally.
people: 核心人物是賽義德·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·哈桑（Sayyid Mohammed Abdullah Hassan，一八五六至一九二〇），後世稱「瘋僧」，他自一八九九年起在索馬里蘭建立以「迪萬」為核心的教政政權，一九〇〇年三月率部奪取杰吉加的埃塞俄比亞守軍之後，把矛頭正式指向英屬索馬里蘭。他身邊最能打的幾位是奧加丹地區的部族領袖努爾·艾哈邁德·阿曼，先與英方接洽而後加入德里維什，一九〇二年陣亡；還有善於周旋的哈吉·易卜拉欣·伊斯梅爾，出身哈布爾·阿瓦勒氏族，先與英方談判，後被派往德里維什一方主事，一九一三年代表德里維什與英方議和；以及常年在英屬索馬里蘭、義屬索馬里蘭與阿比西尼亞之間游走的軍事指揮官穆罕默德·奧斯曼·奧馬爾，一九〇三年被義軍擒獲並處決。英方的主角是駐索馬里蘭總督查爾斯·埃傑頓爵士，他的任期正好覆蓋衝突最激烈的一九〇〇至一九〇三年；索馬里蘭駱駝兵團初期由一批英國軍官與士官帶訓，其中鄧肯·格拉斯福德就在一九〇一年的戰鬥中陣亡，成為最早一批陣亡的英籍軍官之一；一九〇四年率義軍深入內陸的則是義大利將軍馬里奧·皮波·費雷羅。
peopleEn: The central figure was Sayyid Mohammed Abdullah Hassan (1856-1920), known to later generations as the Mad Mullah, who built the theocratic polity in Somaliland around the diwan from 1899; after taking the Ethiopian garrison at Jigjiga in March 1900 he turned his guns formally on British Somaliland. The most capable of his lieutenants were Nur Ahmed Aman, an Ogaden clan leader who first dealt with the British, then joined the Dervishes and was killed in 1902; Haji Ibrahim Ismail of the Habr Awal clan, a skilled negotiator who first talked with the British and was later put in charge of business for the Dervish side, and who in 1913 concluded a settlement with the British on their behalf; and Mohammed Osman Omar, a military commander who moved between British Somaliland, Italian Somaliland and Abyssinia and was captured by the Italians in 1903 and executed. On the British side the leading figure was Sir Charles Egerton, Governor of British Somaliland, whose term of office covered the fiercest years of the fighting, from 1900 to 1903. The Somaliland Camel Corps was trained in its early days by a body of British officers and non-commissioned officers; among them Duncan Glasfurd fell in the fighting of 1901 and became one of the first British officers killed in the campaign. The Italian offensive of 1904 was led by General Mario Pippo Ferrero.
kits: 卡面上的加特林機槍是一八六〇年美國人理查德·喬丹·加特林造出的多管轉輪後膛速射槍，手搖曲柄帶動槍管旋轉依次擊發，靠人工操作達到遠超當時步槍的持續射擊；在美國陸軍的編制裏，它從一八六〇年代起就是步兵團武器單位屬下的團級支援火力，專責在進攻縱深與正面對射中壓制密集隊形。放到一九〇〇年的索馬里蘭戰場，加特林機槍的位置是後方與側翼的支援火器：英方遠征縱隊在前線的持續火力主要由馬克沁與諾登菲爾特機槍承擔，一九〇二年起更換為維克斯機槍，加特林這類早期速射武器則留在澤拉、貝爾貝拉、哈爾蓋薩一帶的守備單位，以及遠征隊的預備隊與隨隊車列中，用來對付德里維什那種以數百人為單位、密集而緩慢推進的「頭巾隊」，以持續的橫向火力把對方縱隊打散。關於本戰役中加特林機槍的具體運用，英方戰報極少詳載，多以支援火力概稱，諸說並存；可以確定的是，它屬於帝國軍隊十九世紀以來在非洲殖民地戰爭中沿用下來的那一批團級支援武器，與同一戰區仍在使用的義軍阿比西尼亞砲兵同屬一個技術世代。同一戰役裏真正大量消耗的是李·恩菲爾德栓動步槍、舊式馬蒂尼·亨利步槍、馬克沁與維克斯機槍、七磅與十二磅野戰砲；海岸線由皇家海軍魚雷艇與巡洋艦封鎖，內陸運轉全靠駱駝隊，沒有鐵路，飲水是遠征最嚴格的限制。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on the card is the multi-barrelled, cranked, breech-loading rapid-fire weapon built in 1860 by Richard Jordan Gatling in the United States: a hand crank rotates the barrel cluster so that the chambers fire in turn, giving sustained fire far beyond what a single-shot rifle of the period could deliver. In the organisation of the US Army it had been a battalion-level support weapon in the hands of regimental artillery companies since the 1860s, responsible for breaking up massed formations in depth and in frontal exchanges. On the Somaliland battlefield of 1900 the Gatling's place was as support fire on the flanks and in the rear: the sustained fire of the British expeditionary columns was carried mainly by the Maxim and Nordenfelt guns, replaced by the Vickers from 1902, while the older rapid-fire weapons such as the Gatling stayed with the garrisons at Zeila, Berbera and Hargeisa and with the reserve and baggage columns of the expeditions, where they were used against the Dervish turban columns that advanced in dense, slow-moving bodies of several hundred men, sustained lateral fire breaking up their formations. Details of how the Gatling was actually employed in this campaign are rarely set out in British reports, which speak of it only as support fire, and the accounts differ; what can be said with certainty is that it belonged to that generation of battalion support weapons which the imperial armies had carried into the African colonial wars of the nineteenth century, in the same technical generation as the Italian Eritrean batteries still serving in Somalia in the same year. What was consumed in bulk in the same fighting was the Lee-Enfield bolt-action rifle, the older Martini-Henry, the Maxim and Vickers guns, and the 7-pounder and 12-pounder field pieces; the coast was sealed by the Royal Navy's torpedo boats and cruisers, transport inland was done entirely by camel, there was no railway, and water was the strictest limit on every expedition.
tactics: 德里維什一方的戰術是典型的遊牧式集群攻擊：以數百人至數千人的「頭巾隊」密集結隊前進，槍手與矛手混在同一部隊裏，靠人數與聲勢迫敵方開火；選擇正午或午後發動進攻，令對方射手在強光下難以瞄準；夜間逼近英軍據點，切斷水源與糧道；守方則利用石築堡寨的城牆與射孔固守，令遠征隊無法速戰速決。英方的打法相反，人數極少：遠征縱隊通常只有數百人，其中相當部分是騎乘駱駝的索馬里蘭駱駝兵團，配一兩挺機槍與一門野戰砲，靠駱駝在硬土與灌木叢地形上維持每日數十公里的機動，飲水按人頭嚴格配給，縱隊不戀戰，遇戰即以機槍壓制、掩護部隊成散兵線撤回。一九〇四年的冬季遠征把縱隊推進到德里維什國邊緣，因水源、情報與嚮導不足而被迫回撤，是英方最接近塔萊赫的一次；同一年英軍進攻托格德爾霍一帶的堡寨亦未能奏效。此後英方改以封鎖海岸線、拔除前哨、逐步推進的辦法，並在一九〇五年後請皇家海軍從海上攻擊，配合縱隊行動，把封鎖與進攻合為一體；航空與裝甲車要到一九二〇年才真正介入。
tacticsEn: The Dervish tactic was the classic massed rush of a campaigning people: turban columns of several hundred to several thousand men advanced in close order, riflemen and spearmen mixed in the same body, using numbers and noise to force the enemy to fire; attacks were launched at midday or early afternoon so that the enemy's shooters could not see to aim; columns moved on British posts by night to cut their water and supply; and the defenders held on in stone-built forts, using the walls and loopholes so that the expeditions could never take them quickly. The British way was the opposite, and small: an expedition column was normally only a few hundred strong, a large part of it Somaliland Camel Corpsmen mounted on camels, with a machine gun or two and a field gun, relying on the camel to keep up several tens of kilometres a day over hard soil and thorn scrub, water being issued strictly by head-count, and the column refusing to be pinned down: when engaged it broke contact under covering machine-gun fire, the covering party falling back in skirmish order. The winter expedition of 1904 pushed the column to the edge of the Dervish State but had to withdraw for want of water, information and guides, and it was the closest the British came to Taleh; the British assault on the forts around Tog Derho in the same year also failed. After that the British changed to sealing the coast, clearing the forward posts and advancing step by step, and from 1905 they brought the Royal Navy in to strike from the sea in support of the columns, joining blockade and attack into a single operation; aircraft and armoured cars did not come into it in earnest until 1920.
data: 有據可查的數字都是概數，但足以刻出這場戰爭的規模。索馬里蘭駱駝兵團一九〇〇年成立時約五百人，至一九〇二年擴充到約一千五百人，基幹是索馬里青年，軍官與士官多為英國人。英方在索馬里蘭的全線常備兵力長期只有數百名英軍與印度軍，加上一千餘人的駱駝兵團；相對應地，德里維什一方的民兵以數千計，各次戰役參戰人數說法不一，多在四千至五千之間。一九〇〇年至一九二〇年間，英國在索馬里蘭方向先後發動五次大規模遠征，主要在努加爾河谷一帶推進，每次深入內陸一百英里至二百英里不等。塔萊赫距最近海岸線約三百公里，遠征縱隊在無水源地帶每日只能推進數十英里，飲水配給常被壓到每人每日一夸脫上下。雙方的總傷亡數字在各方記述中差異極大，英方與索馬里籍士兵歷年陣亡以千計，德里維什方面的損失同樣難以核實。戰爭列表所載一九〇〇這個年份，指的是英屬索馬里蘭保護地與德里維什國公開交戰的第一年；戰役的徹底結束要等到一九二〇年英軍攻佔塔萊赫。
dataEn: The documented figures are round ones, but enough to fix the scale of the war. The Somaliland Camel Corps numbered about five hundred men when it was raised in 1900 and was expanded to about fifteen hundred by 1902, its backbone being Somali youths with British officers and non-commissioned officers. The whole British force in Somaliland was chronically only a few hundred British and Indian soldiers plus the camel corps' thousand-odd men; the Dervish militia, by contrast, numbered in the thousands, and the strength fielded in any one action is reported inconsistently, most often at between four and five thousand. Between 1900 and 1920 Britain mounted five major expeditions in the Somaliland direction, mainly in the Nugaal valley, each pushing one hundred to two hundred miles inland. Taleh lies roughly three hundred kilometres from the nearest stretch of coast, and in country without water an expedition column could advance only a few tens of miles a day, the water ration often being cut to around a gallon a day for each man. Totals for casualties on both sides differ enormously between accounts; British and Somali soldiers killed over the years run into the thousands, and the Dervish losses are just as impossible to verify. The year 1900 in the war list refers to the first year of open fighting between the British Somaliland Protectorate and the Dervish State; the campaign did not end for good until the British took Taleh in 1920.
cause: 起因是宗教動員與殖民權力在索馬里亞內陸的正面碰撞。一八九九年起，穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·哈桑以「衛道者」的名義在部落之間推行團結，令各氏族以同一誓詞結盟，公開否定英國在一八九〇年代同索馬里各氏族簽訂的保護條約，也拒絕承認阿比西尼亞對奧加丹地區的主張；一九〇〇年三月，德里維什攻下杰吉加的埃塞俄比亞守軍，隨即把旗幟指向英屬索馬里蘭。英方出兵，除卻應付邊境襲擊，還有很實際的利害：內陸的商路與通往哈拉爾的通道被德里維什控制，英國無法在亞丁灣腹地開展貿易與傳教活動，沿海城鎮的安定亦無從保證；義大利在紅海沿岸與英國的角力，更令英方擔心索馬里蘭的邊界會被德里維什的擴張牽動。一九〇三年英國與阿比西尼亞達成的協議，把奧加丹的爭端轉成對付德里維什的共同立場；衝突於是由零星襲擊演成制度化的邊境戰爭，一九〇四年英義就共同出兵達成的協議，則把一場英方的地方戰役變成兩大帝國聯手對付一個國家的行動。
causeEn: The cause was the collision of religious mobilisation with colonial power in the interior of Somalia. From 1899 Mohammed Abdullah Hassan pushed unity among the clans under the banner of the dervishes, binding them together with a common oath, openly denying the treaties of protection Britain had signed with Somali clans in the 1890s and refusing to acknowledge Abyssinia's claims to the Ogaden. In March 1900 the Dervishes took the Ethiopian garrison at Jigjiga and turned their flag towards British Somaliland. The British went to war for reasons beyond simply answering raids in the borderland: the caravan routes and the road to Harar were in Dervish hands, Britain could not open up trade and missionary work in the hinterland of the Gulf of Aden, and the security of the coastal towns was never assured; the Italian contest with Britain along the Red Sea coast added the fear that the Dervish advance would drag the Somaliland frontier about. An agreement between Britain and Abyssinia in 1903 turned the quarrel over the Ogaden into a common front against the Dervishes; the clash grew from scattered attacks into a regular frontier war, and the agreement Italy and Britain reached in 1904 on acting together turned a local British war into a campaign by two empires against a state.
impact: 影響分幾層。第一層在戰區本身：德里維什國長年佔據內陸，實際上切斷了英屬索馬里蘭的內陸商路與牧場，沿海城鎮的物價與牲畜供給長期受影響，英方的治理只能停在海岸線與主要驛道；為此付出的軍費在英國國內成為常被引用的例子，一支規模不大的常備軍在這樣一場長期邊境戰爭裡維持了二十年，被視為帝國行政成本高昂的典型。第二層在軍事技術上：索馬里蘭駱駝兵團把「本地步兵加駱駝」的路子走通了，騎乘駱駝的機槍組成為英國在沙漠與半沙漠地區的標準配置，遠征隊的飲水配給、隨行車列與索馬里嚮導制度都成了後來殖民地遠征的範本。第三層在政治與文獻上：這場戰爭把「瘋僧」塑造成反殖民抵抗的象徵，一九二〇年之後，這段歷史被寫進小說與報導，遠遠傳出索馬里蘭。
impactEn: The effects worked on several levels. First in the theatre itself: for years the Dervish State held the interior and in practice cut British Somaliland's inland trade routes and grazing grounds, while the price of food and the supply of livestock in the coastal towns were affected for the whole period, and British administration could advance no further than the coast and the main caravan tracks; the money this cost became a standard example at home in Britain, where a small regular army was kept fighting a long frontier war for two decades, the standing illustration of what imperial administration could come to. Second, in military technique: the Somaliland Camel Corps showed that a native infantry mounted on camels could work, and camel-mounted machine-gun groups became a standard formation in British desert and semi-desert operations; the water rationing of the expedition columns, the baggage train and the system of Somali guides all became models for later colonial expeditions. Third, in politics and in writing: the war made the Mad Mullah an emblem of anti-colonial resistance, and after 1920 the story was carried into novels and reportage far beyond Somaliland.
result: 就一九〇〇至一九〇四年這一段而言，結果是英方保住了海岸線與城鎮、把前哨與商路一段段收回，卻始終沒有攻下塔萊赫；德里維什國照樣維持自己的行政與軍隊，在內陸繼續存在，兩國邊界成為一片沒有實測地圖的荒漠帶。索馬里蘭駱駝兵團由最初的五百人擴成維持全線的主力，證明本地人編成的駝兵可以在旱地打贏正規的殖民地部隊，但戰術上仍然只能靠人數與地形的交換來換取推進。真正改變局面的因素有三樣：英義的合作、一九〇五年以後海陸配合的封鎖作戰、以及一九二〇年英軍投入的裝甲車與飛機。最後英軍攻佔塔萊赫，德里維什國崩潰，瘋僧逃入奧加丹，同年病逝。卡面上的加特林機槍也隨之退場：它是團級支援火器的典型，在這場戰爭裏擔當的是側翼與預備隊的持續火力，而真正改變火力平衡的，是馬克沁與維克斯機槍，最後是一九二〇年的飛機。
resultEn: For the 1900 to 1904 phase the result was that the British kept the coast and the towns and recovered the forward posts and the caravan roads piece by piece, yet never took Taleh; the Dervish State kept its own administration and its own armed force, continued to exist in the interior, and the border between the two became a belt of desert without a surveyed map on either side. The Somaliland Camel Corps grew from its initial five hundred into the standing force that held the whole line, proving that a corps of camel-borne Somalis could beat regular colonial troops on dry ground, though tactically it could still only buy forward movement by trading numbers and ground. What finally changed the situation came in three things: the Anglo-Italian partnership, the combined blockade-and-attack warfare at sea and on land from 1905 onwards, and the armoured cars and aircraft the British brought in during 1920. The British finally took Taleh, the Dervish State collapsed, the Mad Mullah fled into the Ogaden and died there the same year. The Gatling gun on the card retired with it: it was the typical battalion support weapon, its part in this war was sustained fire on the flank and in reserve, and what really shifted the balance of firepower was the Maxim and the Vickers, and finally the aircraft of 1920.
